audit_metadata.event: IBM Quantum Qiskit Fall Fest SRMAP 2026 (Phase 1)
audit_metadata.audit_type: Independent Processor A/B Benchmark Evidence Audit
audit_metadata.verdict_summary: Official Processor A/B topologies, JSON configs, and 6Q transpilation benchmarks (depth 15, 5 CX, 0 SWAP) are fully verified and reproduced. Two reporting and simulation qualifications require correction: (1) Aer EstimatorV2 does not simulate readout error and requires physical observable mapping for transpiled circuits, and (2) the claim of noise resilience from a single sample comparison is statistically invalid.

processor_A.capacity_handling: VERIFIED: CircuitTooWideForTarget correctly raised for 6Q approved VQC; adheres to Challenge Kit Section 3.1 & Section 12 policy

discrepancies_identified.description: Readout error is not applied by Qiskit Aer EstimatorV2 because the circuit lacks explicit measurement instructions and EstimatorV2 evaluates expectation values directly via operator contraction.
discrepancies_identified.impact: Low on uncompiled comparison; must be clearly disclosed in the report.

discrepancies_identified.description: The circuit passed to simulate_processor_b in the initial benchmark JSON was the uncompiled 6-qubit logical circuit rather than the 9-qubit transpiled circuit. Single-qubit depolarizing error was not applied to ry gates because the noise model defines 1Q errors only for native basis gates ['x', 'sx'].
discrepancies_identified.impact: Evaluating the fully transpiled 9Q circuit with re-indexed 9Q observable yields an expectation of 0.241681 (shift of +0.001645 vs ideal 0.240036).

discrepancies_identified.description: seed_simulator was passed inside backend_options instead of run_options in EstimatorV2, causing the Gaussian shot-noise sampler to use an unseeded RNG across independent calls.
discrepancies_identified.impact: Passing seed_simulator in run_options resolves this and guarantees bit-exact simulation repeatability.

discrepancies_identified.description: The claim that the model possesses 'high noise tolerance' based solely on a single sample parameter comparison (|delta E| < sigma) is statistically invalid. Shot-noise standard error reflects sample variance, not hardware resilience.
discrepancies_identified.impact: Must be corrected in report/processor_ab_topology_research.md; true noise resilience requires full cohort evaluation.
